title: Smiling Women Pitching Down: Auditing Representational and Presentational Gender Biases in Image Generative AI

bias_targets.methodology: Generating images for 153 occupations using DALL·E 2, comparing the outputs to Google Images search results and 2021 US Census labor statistics, and applying computer vision (AWS Rekognition) to measure representational disparities (male vs. female proportions) and presentational biases (differences in smiling, calmness, and downward-pitching head pose).
